Colombo Municipal Council - Standard By-Laws --
This Gazette Extraordinary has been Canceled ...........
reasoning: This gazette content deals with the legal status and revocation of a previous gazette publication (No. 2269/70) based on constitutional authority (Thirteenth Amendment) and statutory interpretation. It references specific legal provisions (Section 3(4) of Local Authorities (Standard By-Laws) and Sections 267, 268 of the Municipal Council Ordinance) and discusses the override of powers by executive authority under constitutional law. The content is primarily concerned with legal validity, constitutional interpretation, and the revocation of a legal instrument, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural issue.
